- gain_key: Field required
price_tradeoff accepts:
- snapshot_id (string, required): The snapshot every figure is read from, by the id its freeze returned.
- gain_key (string, required): The axis the trade's gain is read on: a measure with a direction, or a judged dimension, by the key campaign_overview lists.
- arm_filter (optional string, default null): Read only this arm, by its id in the snapshot; omitted reads every arm.
- slice_filter (optional string, default null): Price within this one task, stratum or cell only, by its id (a cell as <row>.<column>), on the slice's own figures; omitted prices overall.
- what_if (optional string, default null): Also price this option the gates remove or leave undecided, as if it passed: a labelled what-if, never a recommendation; omitted for none.
- limit (optional integer, default null): The most rows to return, up to 200.
- offset (integer, default 0): Skip this many rows; the previous page's next_offset.
